text: FormatException: Unexpected character in Dart is misdiagnosed almost every time. The offset tells you which of four real bugs you have: an HTML error page from a 404, a UTF-8 BOM the server prepends, package:http silently falling back to latin-1 because Content-Type lacked a charset, or a server that double-encoded the JSON. Print bodyBytes.take(8) before you touch jsonDecode.
